title: Ollama Context Length: Fix 4k Limits for Big Files
description:
Your local model forgets big files? One setting fixes it. ⚡

✅ Small GPUs default to 4k tokens
✅ Set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH when you serve
✅ Check it with ollama ps

Day 7 of Local AI Coding. Next up: Day 8, Route Easy Tasks Local, Hard Ones Cloud.
Follow for a new short every day and build your local AI setup.

#shorts #ollama #localllm #localai #aicoding #coding #aitools
comment: 4k or 32k: which would you set first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: a bigger context uses more memory, so run ollama ps after you serve to confirm the CONTEXT column shows the value you set.
